arabic text: MAZLOOM KA JANAZA, MAZDOOR LAA RAHE HAI’N
english translation text: Maula Raza's father is departing from this world; labourers carry the oppressed one's funeral bier.

arabic text: BAGHDAD KA JO PUL HAI, US PER RAKHI HAI GHATRI\nMAYYIT PE RONE WAALA WARIS NAHI HAI KOI\nIS HAAL PER PARAAE AANSU BAHA RAHE HAI’N
english translation text: Upon Baghdad's bridge lies a bundle.\nNo heir remains to weep over the body.\nSeeing this state, even strangers shed tears.

arabic text: PANDRA BARAS RAHE HAI’N ZINDA’N MEI’N MERE MOLA\nSARWAR KI LAADLI KA PARHTE RAHE HAI’N NOHA\nMARTE HUWE BHI UNKA NOHA SUNA RAHE HAI’N
english translation text: My Maula spent fifteen years in prison,\nreciting the lament of Sarwar's beloved daughter.\nEven as he died, he continued reciting her noha.

arabic text: AISA ASAR DIKHAYA HAROON KE ZEHER NE\nZANJEER MEI’N ULAJH KAR UTRE BADAN KE TUKRE\nMAYYIT NAHI’N KAFAN MEI’N TUKRE UTHA RAHE HAI’N
english translation text: Harun's poison showed such an effect\nthat pieces of the body became entangled in the chains.\nThey do not lift a body into the shroud—they lift its pieces.

arabic text: PACHEESWEE’N RAJAB KO TOOTI AJAB QAYAMAT\nHAI SAATWEI’N ALI KI DUNYA SE AAJ RULHSAT\nJANNAT ME FARSHE MATAM, HAIDER BICHAA RAHE HAI
english translation text: On the twenty-fifth of Rajab, a strange Judgement Day arose.\nThe seventh Ali departs from this world today.\nIn Paradise, Haider spreads the mourning floor.

arabic text: DO BETIYON KI HAAYE QISMAT HAI EK JAISI\nRO BHI NAHI SAKI HAI’N MAYYIT PE WHO PADAR KI\nSAIDAANIYO’N KO ZALIM KITNA SATAA RAHE HAI’N
english translation text: Alas, two daughters shared the same destiny:\nneither could weep over her father's body.\nHow greatly the tyrants tormented the Sayyid ladies.

arabic text: KAZIM KI LAASH HAYE JIS WAQT PUL PE POHNCHI\nRONE KO AAGAYI THI PEHLU SHIKASTA BIBI\nLE KAR BEHN KO APNI AABID BHI AA RAHE HAI’N
english translation text: When Kazim's body reached the bridge,\nthe Lady of the broken side came to weep.\nTaking his sister with him, Abid too arrived.

arabic text: AZLAAN AZMI JAB MAI’N KAAZMAIN POHNCHA\nDEKHA KARIM MAINE MOLA KA QAID KHANA\nAB TAK WOHI MANAZIR MUJHKO RULA RAHE HAI’N
english translation text: O Azlaan Azmi, when I reached Kazimayn,\nI saw, O Karim, my Maula's prison.\nEven now, those scenes continue to make me weep.
